name: table
label: Table
description: Table name of the record on which agent assist appears

name: sysId
label: Sys ID
description: Sys ID of the record on which agent assist appears

name: fields
label: Form fields
description: Form fields from the record on which agent assist appears

name: isNewRecord
label: Is new record
description: Specify whether the record on which agent assist appears is a new record or not

name: positionAbsolutely
label: Position absolutely
description: Specify whether component should be positined absolutely, please use it when placing Agent Assist inside contextual side panel

name: prefetchData
label: Prefetch Data
description: Prefetch for results in Agent Assist. Typically used with the Agent Assist prefetch data broker

name: isFetching
label: Is fetching
description: Specify whether data fetch using a data broker is in progress. Typically used with the Agent Assist prefetch data broker

name: usePreferredResourceOnLoad
label: Use preferred resource on load
description: Use the user preference for resource on load
